slides.body: five reasons slovenia is a great first solo trip. save this post.

slides.text:
one of the *safest*
countries in the world

slides.head: why women travel here *alone*
slides.body: low crime. easy to walk everywhere. and most people speak english.

slides.head: the old town has *no cars*
slides.body: just the river, small bridges, and cafes. calm and easy to walk.

slides.head: the best *view*
slides.body: take the cable car up to the castle. you see the whole city and the alps.

slides.head: a tip most people *miss*
slides.body: the small "kavalir" cart is free. locals use it to cross the old town.

slides.head: one *easy* day trip
slides.body: lake bled is 40 minutes by bus. see the island church, walk around the lake, come back the same day.

slides.lead: five simple tips. one easier trip.
